user.title: SPO Pool Heat Pump
user.description:
This integration speaks Modbus RTU on RS-485. Wire and join the USR-DR164 first. Full walkthrough (wiring photo, Wi-Fi, work mode): [README](https://github.com/spongioblast/spo_pool_heat_pump/blob/main/README.md)

1. **Wire:** parallel tap +, A, B, and G on the same four pins as the factory WiFi. A separate DC− screw joins G. Swap A/B if CRC fails.
2. **LAN:** phone joins `USR-DR164-xxxx` → `http://10.10.100.254` → `admin`/`admin`. Change the password. STA to the home Wi-Fi; reserve the DHCP lease.
3. **Work mode:** Serial Port **9600 8N1**, Packaging Interval **20 ms**, Length **1400**. Socket A **TCP Server**, port **8899**. Not Modbus gateway, MQTT, HTTP, PUSR cloud, heartbeat, or Event.

Enter that reserved IP below. One Home Assistant client only. Serial USB and Modbus-TCP gateways are not available in v1.

data_description.host: Reserved LAN IP of the USR-DR164. One Home Assistant TCP client only.
data_description.port: Socket A port. Factory default is 8899.

profile.title: Heat pump profile
profile.description:
{detect_note}

Keep that choice unless the name on the case is a different family. Compatible badges are listed on each option.

data_description.profile: Pick by how the unit talks, not only the sticker. Oasis / Warmpool / ECPI / irriPool → Hayward. Azuro / Mountfield → MIDA Cosma. SuperMini / Thermotec → PHNIX Mini. Fairland/Norsup menu H37 slave 50 → CN13. IPS Pro / InverX / IPHCR → coil map. Not listed? Unknown heat pump — dump only. AquaTemp on the phone does not prove this wire map.

options_setup.title: Options
options_setup.description: {bus_note} Write path defaults to the second panel (slave 2): Home Assistant answers the board like a second display and hands it changed settings the same way the wired display does. It needs no WiFi module. Slave 99 addresses the factory WiFi module and is unverified. Service settings (H/F/D special-menu parameters) can damage the unit. Leave them off unless you know the OEM values.

data_description.name: How this heat pump appears in Home Assistant.
data_description.write_path: Keep second panel (slave 2). It is the mechanism the wired display uses and works with or without a WiFi module. Slave 99 only addresses the factory module and is unverified; panel address 1 is unproven.
data_description.poll_interval: How often Fairland-style units are polled. Cosma and Mini broadcast and ignore this.
data_description.service_menu_writes: Leave this off unless you know the OEM numbers. Wrong H, F, or D values can damage or brick the heat pump.
data_description.poll_slave: Fairland CN13 menu H37. Default 50. IPS Pro is usually 1.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure DR164
reconfigure.description: Change the reserved LAN IP or port if the DR164 moved. Profile, write path, and H37 stay under Configure.
